note: Step 4 deterministic checks. The Synder design-token diff in VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL Step 4 was intentionally SKIPPED: this prototype is ETC Solutions' PIMS product (Material Design 2, primary #1976d2), not Synder (#0053CC, 8px grid). Diffing it against synder-design-tokens.css or DESIGN_RULES.md would manufacture findings rather than find them. Mechanical checks that do apply were run instead.
checked: font families across every rendered element
every inline handler resolves to a function that exists
contrast ratio of every state line, counter, hint, meta value and field label against its real background

findings.element: Prompt field (#prompt) in the ELA zone
findings.finding: Switching Quelle away from Standard and back collapsed the Prompt field to 0px height, leaving it invisible and unusable.
findings.cause: render() auto-sized the textarea while its container was still display:none, so scrollHeight was 0; the inline height:0px then survived the container becoming visible again.

evidence.action: select Quelle = Library, then Quelle = Standard, then try to click the Prompt field
evidence.observed: #blkStandard visible:true but #prompt visible:false — Playwright timed out waiting for it to become visible

findings.status: FIXED before the validators were spawned
findings.fix: The source blocks are now toggled before any auto-sizing, and growOne() refuses to size an element that has no layout.

findings.finding: The close button had no font-family and fell back to Arial instead of Roboto.

evidence.action: read computed fontFamily on every rendered element
evidence.observed: BUTTON.x-btn :: Arial — the only non-Roboto element on the page

findings.fix: font-family: inherit added to .x-btn. No visible effect today (the button contains only an SVG) but it would have shown the moment a character was placed in it.

not_findings.detail: padding 21px/5px on .tf and margin-top 26px on .sec-t are off the 4px increment.
not_findings.why_not_a_finding: 21px top / 5px bottom is the Material Design 2 filled-text-field metric, which this product follows deliberately. The 4/8px grid rule comes from the Synder design system and does not govern this prototype. Reporting it would be a false positive.

clean: every inline handler resolves — no dead controls
no border-radius above 4px on any action button
no contrast failure: all four state-line colours (grey rgba(0,0,0,.6), green #1e7b34, amber #8a5a00, red #c62828) and both counters clear 4.5:1 against their real backgrounds
0 JS errors and 0 unexpected native dialogs across the whole recon pass
